name: ServerHoster
author: Widgeter
description: Live status of every service on your ServerHoster / LocalSURV server, fetched from its API using an SSH-obtained session token.

config.label: SSH login (user@host)
config.help: SSH user and address of the server running ServerHoster. The user needs passwordless sudo to read the session token.

config.label: SSH private key file
config.help: Local path to the key used to log in (key-based login only, no password prompts).

config.label: API URL (optional)
config.help: Leave empty to use http://<host>:8787 from the SSH login. If the API port is not reachable from here, the widget asks the server over SSH instead.

config.label: Dashboard user (optional)
config.help: Only used together with the dashboard password below.

config.label: Dashboard password (optional)
config.help: ServerHoster sessions expire. With a password the widget logs in itself; without one it reuses the dashboard session it finds over SSH.
